name.ja: ENTRY GRADE 仮面ライダーゼロワン ライジングホッパー
name.en: ENTRY GRADE Kamen Rider Zero-One Rising Hopper

description.ja: 全てのプラモデル未経験者に贈る入門用シリーズ「ENTRY GRADE」に『仮面ライダーゼロワン』より仮面ライダーゼロワン ライジングホッパーが登場！
description.en: Kamen Rider Zero-One Rising Hopper from "Kamen Rider Zero-One " appears in the introductory series " ENTRY GRADE" given to all plastic model inexperienced people!

description.ja: • スーツにアーマーをはめ込む、変身をイメージした組み立てが楽しい！
description.en: • It's fun to assemble the armor into a suit, which is inspired by transformation!

description.ja: • 少ないパーツ数(27パーツ)と完成形をイメージしやすいランナー配置で、プラモデルを初めて作る方でもサクサクと組み立てが可能！
description.en: • With a small number of parts (27 parts) and a runner layout that makes it easy to imagine the finished product, even those who make plastic models for the first time can quickly assemble it!

description.ja: • 特殊な加工でスーツの質感の違いを再現。プラモデルの精密さを体験できる！
description.en: • Special processing reproduces the different textures of the suit. You can experience the precision of plastic models!

description.ja: • 接着剤、工具不要！スナップフィット、タッチゲート方式で簡単組み立てが可能！
description.en: • No glue or tools required! Easy assembly with snap fit and touch gate method!
